description: Rename an attribute in schema.json, plus (for a RELATION) its populate/filters usages by name via the relation-field index. ⚠️ Does NOT rewrite object/data-access usages (`entity.field`, `data: { field }`, destructuring, populated results) — those are untyped property access we cannot rewrite without guessing; the result always warns to review them by hand. NOT a complete field rename. Dry-run (+ `planId`); apply with `apply_edits`.

configSync.description: With strapi-plugin-config-sync: also update the config/sync files this refactor concerns (roles' permissions, content-manager views) to the new names. Default: true (the strapiDevkit.configSync.followRefactors setting; DEVKIT_CONFIG_SYNC_FOLLOW_REFACTORS=0 for a standalone server). Pass false when config/sync is not yours to change here (exported from another environment). The plan's warnings say which sync files it updates, or leaves with the old names.

from.description: A path inside the target project (e.g. the file you are editing). Disambiguates a multi-project workspace.

project.description: A project name (its folder) or root path. Use when you have no file path in hand.

name: plan_rename_attribute
